class.name: OcgPolyMergenodestool
class.brief_description: Auxiliary tool for merging triangulation nodes for visualization purposes. Tool tries to merge all nodes within input triangulation, but split the ones on sharp corners at specified angle.
class.description: ! Auxiliary tool for merging triangulation nodes for visualization purposes. ! Tool tries to merge all nodes within input triangulation, but split the ones on sharp corners at ! specified angle.

method.name: computeTriNormal
method.description: Compute normal for the mesh element.

method.name: AddTriangulation
method.description: Add another triangulation to created one.

method.name: Result
method.description: Prepare and return result triangulation (temporary data will be truncated to result size).

method.name: PushLastElement
method.description: Add new triangle or quad with nodes specified by ChangeElementNode().

method.name: PushLastTriangle
method.description: Add new triangle with nodes specified by ChangeElementNode().

method.name: PushLastQuad
method.description: Add new quad with nodes specified by ChangeElementNode().

method.name: ChangeOutput
method.description: Setup output triangulation for modifications. When set to NULL, the tool could be used as a merge map for filling in external mesh structure.

method.name: MergeNodes
method.description: Merge nodes of existing mesh and return the new mesh.
